Coffee Prices Increase After Credit Card Surcharge Ban

Following a ban on credit card surcharges, some cafes in Australia have increased coffee prices. This measure, intended by the Reserve Bank to lower costs for consumers, has resulted in an unintended consequence of higher prices, with some reports indicating a rise of up to 10% or 50 cents per coffee.
